set.body:
Scope:
Improve pipeline ergonomics over RemoteRef, ArtifactRef, TaskSubmission, and total TaskOutcome without introducing a separate workflow scheduler or DAG database.

Acceptance criteria:
- Helpers cover downstream submission from stored results/artifacts, fan-out, fan-in, and bounded parallel traversal.
- Composition passes large values by durable reference and preserves schema/digest checks.
- Failed, interrupted, unknown, and publication-failed upstream outcomes are preserved explicitly and cannot be mistaken for absent values.
- Cancellation and Resource lifetimes remain structured under Cats Effect.
- Helpers compose equally over local, batch, and leased-pool runners.
- Memoized and newly executed results are observationally equivalent at the composition surface.
- Documentation includes realistic typed file-producing and scientific-pipeline examples.
- A DAG persistence engine, automatic elastic scaling, and cross-process workflow coordinator remain explicit non-goals pending a concrete requirement.
set.title: SOJ.O4: Add lightweight durable-reference composition helpers
